svg.title: Same lattice change, two different physical scenes
svg.desc: Top: a fixed 24×24 material array deforms the pixels and pattern. Bottom: a fixed physical circle of radius 120 nm retains its shape while only the repetition lattice changes.
svg.text: Same lattice change, two different physical scenes
A pixelated approximation of a circle
The same pixels move, deforming the pattern
Shapes: keep centre (0,0) and physical diameter 240 nm
Same xy scale · lattice-vector lengths stay 600 nm · top: staircase approximation; bottom: exact circle geometry
